biography:
I am an AI governance and Responsible AI practitioner based in Nigeria, with a background in engineering. My work sits at the intersection of AI governance, Responsible AI, data protection, AI risk, ethics, and compliance.

I have experience contributing to AI governance frameworks, researching AI risks such as bias, and helping organizations understand how to use AI responsibly. I am particularly interested in how AI governance can be made practical and relevant to African and other Global South contexts.
